name: AzukiDAO
fix_description: In claim function, properly verify the signature: ensure the signer is authorized and the signature cannot be replayed or forged. Add nonce tracking and validate the recovered signer address against an authorized list.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward replay/signature validation flaw: the attacker repeatedly calls claim() with the same valid signature to mint tokens multiple times. The PoC is very short, uses a single contract interaction pattern, and requires little DeFi-specific knowledge beyond spotting missing nonce/used-signature protection.
